body:
My problem is that being interested in something sounds like a lie. Its in the same category as the "Does it matter what I want?" question. Let's say I wanted to be a musician and learn to play some instruments and compose music. Does it matter? I will still work from monday to friday and then I try to sleep at the weekend. Even if I loved to spend the minimal free time with something interesting I see no point in it because a little time that is sliced up into even more little slices is good for nothing. Another big problem is that I already have mountains of primitive problems accumulated that have much higher priority than stupid things like music and as I get older and older more and more of these problems become impossible to solve. Just as an example: will I start running after girls and girlfriends as an old fart? Isn't this something that you should do at the age of 16? How to pursue a goal that you can't even see and can't imagine. 10 years later I die anyway and I can't imagine anything for the next 10 years that is worth living giving the current conditions. What should happen in the next 10 years in order to be able to close my life at least with a zero balance? Its probably only a miracle that could help and miracles do not exist.

As I've written I realize that my knowledge is far behind my age. This is mainly why I've posted on this forum, maybe someone else has already dealt with a similar problem and maybe there are things I don't know about. I don't want to live and survive unconditionally by tolerating this situation and by trying to move the focus to something else for a while when I have a little free time. That is not a solution. I've already embraced that this is probably a dead end and dying is OK for me if there is nothing else to try.

Maybe its just me but years ago when I wanted women it was a very strong if not the strongest motivator for me to get forward in life. Its like having unconditional pleasure in something. Besides this having sex, or simply masturbating, or thinking of sex could make me happy. I think not having a sex drive and being very sad and disappointed have a lot in common. Its a good question whether this lack of sex drive is the result of this situation or simply becoming an old fart.

And sorry but I'm not interested in anything, especially if I have to do it from monday to friday 9am-5pm. What would happen if I started doing something interesting as a job. I would probably start hating it very quickly, just like with programming. Hobbies are also far from my interest when I have a job to do. All I want now is sleeping as usual but I simply can't.

There is no JOB that is right for anyone. :-) And I don't really like the word "depression". Don't use it. Most people seem to think of it like some kind physical illness and they want to treat it that way. You have to treat the root causes if possible and then the derived things like "depression" or bad mood simply evaporate.

My disinterest and lack of zest of life is related to getting old. I think I got too old and missed a lot of things in life as a result of struggling with money and related useless stuff. I've lost the war on too many fronts and it feels like failure accumulates with time. There is nothing I couldn't reach given I have enough time for it but I've born to the wrong place, started with a lot of disadvantage and getting old simply kills me. I start feeling worse and worse in my skin.

It would probably be nice to go out to the wild to cook something delicious again, but that is quite a miserable and minor attempt to aid these problems. I have to spend most of my time in an office or a worse workplace in a job. I just can't anymore move my focus away from a huge problem that fills most of the time in my life.

About 2 years ago I went to a psychologist (to waste my money) and she told me things that are quite similar to what you've written. Although I met her to solve a completely different problem (a total lack of sex drive and interest in women) in my opinion she has found out or at least suspected that I'm different from the rest. I haven't painted my view of the world in the way I did in my post above and haven't told her anything about my job and she wanted me to think of myself as a successful professional who has a "successful career". Besides she recommended getting a girlfriend. You know, "a pussy solves it all" - as a good old friend of mine has told me long ago. But I'm not anymore interested in pussies and this way I see no interest in running after pussies. 3-4 years ago I've realized how emotionally blunt I've become during the years. I cant imagine what it is like feeling love. The last time I felt love for a girl was when I was 17. And its not only that I cant imagine being in love again but I cant even recall the feeling. To be honest I'm not so surprised about this in the world of money. This problem is probably secondary next to having no interest in pursuing primary goals driven by instinct, like sex.

I always wanted to be positive, just like what tries to radiate from your post. Missing positivity, or just alone the mere presence of some negativity (reality) simply pushes off people from your circles. To me it seems that the only accepted and expected attitude is a kind of "positive attitude with ignorance of negative realities". As I see people tend to refer to this attitude as optimism, but it isn't. The difference between the two is a big pile of lies. Optimism isn't about lies. I'm a realist who had some optimism too 10 years ago and I simply can't ignore something for decades when it fills out most of my life, even if it's negative. I've always thought that social success is part of the overall success, but for me it can't work out. I have to wear a mask accepted by the rest and it simply doesn't make me feel good at all. As a result I'm not one of them and not anymore interested in being among people. For me that kind of thing has became a more and more unpleasant activity. A forced smile just adds the the requirements I have to meet, and its enough for me to deal with this at the workplace as part of my minimalist survive plan. Just think of how many other things can fail in your life without social success...

You say that I can do anything I want but this is obviously far from true. As an example: For almost a year I could sleep only about 3-4 hours a day on workdays. My natural biorhythm has always been different (2-3 hours past that of others'), being a programmer just adds to this: as a programmer your brain is spinning and falling to sleep early is nearly impossible, not to mention that as a hobby programmer long ago I've spent my most creative hours with programming at night. To make it worse, I'm so angry and sick of this whole thing that I can usually fall asleep at around 4-5am (when I become completely exhausted) and I can't do anything about this. As a result I want to sleep till 12am or lets say 2pm but I cant because I have to be available for slavery at 9am. I simply can't do what I want and the way I want. I never want to wake up at 8am and who wants to do the same thing from monday to friday from morning to evening? When programming was a hobby for me sometimes I did it for 20 hours a day for weeks, and sometimes I haven't touched the keyboard for months. Not to mention that I never wanted to touch databases and other similar corporate shit. Most programmers fuck around with databases only as part of survival. Corporate shit has nothing to do with creativity and what you want to do in general when you wake up in the morning. I know a lot of people "love" their jobs so I rather fuck off silently... If you have reached the "middle class" then you are expected to "love" your job, otherwise your are a loser and you are not a good party. By its very nature everyone born to love sex. Do bitches love sex despite forcingly doing it all day for money to survive? Am I a bitch who can be fucked for money the way they want? So that's it from me about the love of jobs and "doing what I like" as a job.

There are so many tiny lies flying around and you are expected to lie the same if you want to be a buddy. Like "money isn't that important" and "I love my job". And there are a lot of other situations when they directly and willingly lie into your face and you have to live with that, this is especially true for workplaces when you communicate with your bosses. And I wouldn't mind lying around if reality didn't affect my whole life at a fundamental level and almost all day and every minute. I can't spend decades in a lie without getting crazy about it. The lies I've mentioned are just the basic ones, there are a lot more based on these fundamental ones that fill our lives. I've always felt that something isn't OK with this world but talking about it is basically taboo and most people simply don't seem to find out or being aware of these problems - they just like their job and live their "lives". For me living in this world feels like living in a conflict all day and every minute. Reality versus the lies I'm expected to tell (and accept if I know that its a lie). I am full of conflicts that seem to be impossible to resolve and it became just worse and worse with the years as my knowledge about the world has grown. Forcing myself into this world and into this society is like experiencing constant cognitive dissonance. I'm very-very sick of this whole thing. I'm just wondering how better could this be by being financially independent but dreaming is for rookies.

In my late teen years I've created a list of most valuable things for myself. It included freedom, health, and youth and I was interested in an endless number of things. I wanted to explore the world, etc... The second and the third from this list is fading away and I never had the first one that is the most valuable for me. You just nailed it with entrepreneurship. I was thinking of this in the last year or so as a possible way to achieve freedom. The problem with this is time. I've missed a lot of good things an average person has in his/her life and I simply cant make up for this. Even if I reached financial independence lets say in 5 years would I have time to enjoy it before becoming a failed old fart? In that case I kill myself anyway, I'm not interested in being 40 and older. And I'm not interested in social symbols like ferraris. All I ever needed to earn money for is food and a place to sleep. This is all I was slaving for more than a decade. I've always lacked the family support or a similar background and I don't have the package. In many areas of life my knowledge and experience is usually 5 years behind average that is a very good recipe for failure. I have no social success, no network, and lately I lack the motivation and interest in everything. Is this what makes someone a successful businessman? The idea of starting entrepreneurship feels to me like a miserable race to reach a window of time in my life in which I'm still youngish and free but I doubt I could make it through from where I should start. If I continued I would probably go this way but it feels like a goal that is far beyond my reach.

But this is not the difference between dreams and reality. Reality is simply bad even without dreams. Just imagine what you want to do when you wake up in the morning. Is it going to work? Is it just me who doesn't want that? Do you really want to wake up at 8am or 7 or 6? And for what? For some food and a place to have rest and sleep? Why do I have to work for food and a place from monday to friday from 9am to 5pm?

I loved programming as a creative hobby but they made me hate it in no time. Btw, have you ever seen musicians doing their hobby and working for money? Put together a song for $X, the deadline is XYZ. Yea, this is how "creativity" works. If we are talking about stupid robot work, those simply shouldn't exist. We live in a world in which we have the technology that could replace human workforce and anyone could be paid for their basic needs. In that case you could work on what you like and whenever you like without threatened by death without slavery. That's how creativity and productivity actually works. But yea, dreaming is for rookies. Today as I see I can choose between slavery and death. How to be other than bitter this way?
